featured_reviews.name: Bhagyashree Davane
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is clean, peaceful, and well-maintained, offering a quiet environment that's suitable for focused work or meetings. Although the official address indicates that it is located in Andheri, it's actually situated a bit further away from the Andheri Metro Station. The closest metro stations to reach the location conveniently are Chakala (also known as JB Nagar) and the Western Express Highway metro station. Either of these two stations would be more suitable for access as they are relatively closer compared to Andheri metro.
I visited the location on June 2025, and at that time, the auto rickshaw fare from Andheri station was ₹30 per person, while it was approximately ₹20 per person if you’re coming from Chakala or Western Express Highway stations. This might vary slightly depending on time and traffic, but it gives a good estimate for planning your commute.
One major drawback of this location is the complete lack of food or snack options nearby. There are no eateries or stalls in the vicinity, so if you’re heading there for a meeting or spending a few hours, it is advisable to carry your own water and some food. Another point to keep in mind is that there’s no designated waiting area or benches outside the office premises. Additionally, the receptionist is quite particular and won’t permit visitors to sit for extended periods in the lobby, so it’s best to arrive just on time for your appointment.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hey Bhagyashree, thanks for the detailed review and great to hear your lovely experience with us. Just to notify, there are many food stalls outside the building only. Next time you are here, our staff will help you out :)

The meeting rooms are equipped with state-of-the-art technology, making presentations and video conferences seamless.

The amenities here are top-notch. The high-speed internet is incredibly reliable, and there are plenty of charging stations and outlets. The kitchen area is well-stocked with healthy snacks and great coffee, and the lounge areas are perfect for taking a break and networking with other members.

Speaking of networking, Toutle space  does a fantastic job of fostering a sense of community. The regular events, workshops, and networking sessions are great for meeting like-minded professionals and expanding your business network. The staff, especially the community manager, are always friendly and ready to assist with any needs.

Overall, Toutle space provides a productive, comfortable, and inspiring environment to work in. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a coworking space that truly supports and enhances your work experience.
